homebundle.collaborate.fixed.description: Run the fixed Atlas home-building task with a public two-agent peer, validate the result and return a portable HomeBundle draft and receipt.

returns.receipt: local action result and SHA-256 of the returned bytes

homebundle.collaborate.fixed.failure: Report the first error. Keep the user's existing draft, stop on refusal, and do not retry automatically.

homebundle.author.description: Create and validate a portable draft using your own agent's capabilities.
